name: tabsTitle
description: A heading to add above the tabs. Only used when JavaScript is not available.

name: itemHeadingLevel
description: The heading level which represents an element from `<h1>` through to `<h6>` for each of the tab items.

params.name: id
params.description: A unique ID for the tab item.

params.name: title
params.description: The title of the tab item.

params.name: ariaLabel
params.description: An optional aria-label for the button of the tab item.

params.name: tabTitle
params.description: An optional, shorter heading to use in the tab instead of the `title`.

params.name: body
params.description: The body content of the tab item.

params.name: classes
params.description: Classes to add to the tab item button.

params.name: attributes
params.description: HTML attributes (for example data attributes) to add to the tab item button.

name: activeTabOnLoad
description: If set, the index of the tab to be active on load. Defaults to the first tab. Use `-1` to have no tab active on load.

name: allowClose
description: If `true`, allow tabs to be closed.

name: classes
description: Classes to add to the tabs.

name: attributes
description: HTML attributes (for example data attributes) to add to the tabs.
